takeTheFullPictureWithYou: Take the full picture with you.
buildAFocusedDatasetForYourOwnAnalysisA: Build a focused dataset for your own analysis, a spreadsheet, or an external LLM.
chooseAllMeasurementsLabelsAndNotesInJso: Choose all measurements, labels and notes in JSON for a restorable journal export. The preset includes all recorded dates when they fit within five years; otherwise export your history in separate date ranges. Imports accept up to 500 days per file.
exportUpToFiveYearsAtATime: Export up to five years at a time.
datesTimeZonesSchemaVersionAndRecordTime: Dates, time zones, schema version, and record timestamps are always included.
keepSourceAndHrvMethodSelectedWhenExport: Keep source and HRV method selected when exporting HRV so the measurement remains interpretable.
easyToReadAndShareWithAnLlm: Easy to read and share with an LLM
nestedObjectsUseDottedColumnsWorkoutsAnd: Nested objects use dotted columns; workouts and symptoms remain JSON arrays in cells. CSV omits the data dictionary. Formula-like text is prefixed with an apostrophe for spreadsheet safety.
selectAValidRangeOfUpToFiveYears: Select a valid range of up to five years.
noRecordedDaysInThisRangeChooseDatesCont: No recorded days in this range. Choose dates containing your observations.
selectAtLeastOneMeasurementToExport: Select at least one measurement to export.
thisExportExceedsThe500DayImportLimitFor: This export exceeds the 500-day import limit. For files you can restore directly, choose ranges containing at most 500 recorded days and keep each file below 20 MiB.
theAppNeverSendsThisExportToAnAi: <slot0/> The app never sends this export to an AI provider. You choose where it goes next.
aUsefulPromptStartsWithContext: A useful prompt starts with context.
tellYourLlmYourGoalTheMeasurementRoutine: Tell your LLM your goal, the measurement routine, and any changes in equipment. Ask it to distinguish observations from hypotheses and account for missing data.
